identities.name: NC2 normal-weight concrete (Domagała 2024)
identities.identity_scope: Study-defined NC2 concrete formulation from Domagala et al. (2024), distinct from the already cataloged NC1 formulation by cement, water and superplasticizer input quantities and nominal water/cement ratio. Table 1 reports NC2 cement 470, water 174 and superplasticizer 1.9 kg/m^3 with nominal w/c 0.37, versus NC1 cement 377, water 208 and superplasticizer 0 kg/m^3 with nominal w/c 0.55. These are different mixture recipes, not extra identities for moisture state, curing age or a translated label. Not all normal-weight concrete or all CEM I 42.5 R cement; the cement designation identifies a constituent, not a certified final-concrete grade.

records.name: NC2 concrete, nominal 28-day water-saturated state (Domagała 2024)

product_form.text: Cast cylindrical concrete specimens, nominal diameter 150 mm and length 300 mm

evidence.locator: §2, paragraph beginning Twenty-one standard cylindrical specimens

processing.text: Cast and demolded after 24 h; source reports water storage at 20 °C and nominal testing age 28 days, following EN 12390-2:2019

evidence.locator: §2 specimen preparation paragraph; Table 2, 28-day density rows; reference 22

processing.notes: Source wording says stored for 28 days after demolding yet calls test age 28 days. Preserve nominal reported age rather than infer elapsed 29 days or repair chronology.

temper_or_heat_treatment.notes: Use reported cement curing and moisture conditioning, not a metallic temper.

conditioning.text: Water-saturated for selected wet-density result; wet measurement preceded oven-dry measurement

evidence.locator: §2 paragraph beginning For 28 days; Table 3 D_w column

composition_or_purity.text: NC2 input quantities, kg/m^3: 4/16 mm natural gravel 1140; 0/2 mm natural sand 570; cement CEM I 42.5 R 470; tap water 174; superplasticizer 1.9. Source nominal w/c = 0.37. Coarse aggregate is single-crushed rounded material, predominantly sandstone grains.

evidence.locator: §2 first paragraph and Table 1 NC2 row

composition_or_purity.notes: NC1 uses the same listed gravel/sand quantities but cement 377, water 208 and superplasticizer 0 kg/m^3, with nominal w/c 0.55. Preserve the source recipe and nominal ratio; do not recompute w/c from rounded inputs or infer final phase fractions, supplier, batch identity or admixture chemistry.

reinforcement.notes: No fiber/rebar reinforcement reported in selected formulation. Do not infer reinforcement from aggregate.

porosity.notes: No numerical pore fraction assigned; water absorption is not equated to porosity.

records.source_scope: No structural design allowable, certified grade, universal value or bound. Do not merge 28-day saturated state with 3-year air-dry/saturated experiments. Preserve unknown density basis (bulk/apparent/true terminology not stated by authors for this concrete value), test temperature, porosity and exact test subprocedure. Source 20 °C is curing/storage, not density-test temperature. The source reports demolding after 24 h followed by 28-day water storage while calling the selected testing age 28 days; retain its nominal 28-day designation without inferring 29 days. Density deviations within 20 kg/m³ of the mean are not an SD, confidence interval or uncertainty.
